home.tagline: Run the tournament. Score every point.
home.lead: PowerStats is the live scoring, bracket, and stats console for Ultimate Frisbee tournaments. Built for directors who need accurate data when the disc is in the air.
home.featuresLead: One console for live scoring, brackets, round-robin scheduling, and player analytics. Wire it to a single field or a 64-team championship.
home.liveScoringCopy: Real-time updates for goals, assists, defenses, timeouts, and halves — directly from the field.
home.tournamentFormatsCopy: Flexible support for round-robin pools, single-elimination brackets, and multi-phase playoffs.
home.performanceInsightsCopy: Deep dive into team trends, statistical leaders, and cross-tournament player history.

tournament.title: Tournaments
tournament.subtitle: Every tournament run on PowerStats — past, present, and upcoming. Open one to see the bracket, the leaderboards, and the per-team performance.
tournament.noTournamentsCopy: When an organizer publishes a tournament, it will appear here. Sign in as an admin to create one.
tournament.roundRobinCopy: Every team plays every other team once across {fixtures} fixtures. Top four advance to the bracket.
tournament.playoffsCopy: Single-elimination bracket with quarterfinals, semifinals, and finals — plus consolation games to decide 3rd–6th place.
tournament.leaderboardsCopy: Top scorers, assist leaders, and Spirit of the Game standings.
tournament.bracketSubtitle: Every fixture from the bracket phase — quarterfinals, semifinals, finals, and the consolation games that decide 3rd and 5th place.
tournament.noBracketGamesCopy: Use the admin dashboard to generate the bracket once the round-robin finishes.
tournament.playerStatsSubtitle: Top performers from the tournament — scorers, playmakers, and defenders. Click any player to see their full profile.
